title: Owned entrypoint currently fails configured Ruff checks

evidence.quote:
from app.core.logging import configure_logging, digest_logger
from app.models.digest import Digest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

reasoning: The repository's Ruff configuration selects import sorting and Pyflakes rules. Running ruff on the owned files reports I001 for the import block and F401 because digest_logger is imported but unused, so the configured lint command will fail on this feature.
reproduction: python -m ruff check --no-cache app/main.py app/__init__.py reports I001 and F401 on app/main.py.
recommendation: Remove the unused digest_logger import and sort the import block according to Ruff/isort.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: This is a lint/build gate issue rather than runtime behavior, and no linked tests run Ruff for just this feature.
